itens.descricao: A powerful hand-thrown explosive device. Effective against groups of enemies.
A hand grenade that explodes into flames upon impact. Slows down attackers as well as inflicts damage.
A hand grenade that explodes with a blinding flash. Momentarily hampers enemy movements.
An explosive device that can be planted on the ground. The device is set off by enemies in close proximity to it.
Powerful weapon that can fire six different types of grenades. Ammo is sold separately.
Weapon that launches a high- explosive rocket propelled grenade. Designed to be disposed of after a single use.
This weapon is for Sheva only. A highly effective weapon in terms of damage. It comes with an unlimited supply of arrows.

itens.obs: Nas DLCs existe o modelo uWp12, com o som e os efeitos da Samurai Edge (wp29), e um ícone de pistola. O jogo não dá nome a ela em nenhum texto.
Nas DLCs existe o modelo uWp14: uma faca (modelo da faca da Jill). Sem nome e sem ícone.

itens.descricao: This weapon is for Chris only. The rotating barrels fire a seemingly infinite supply of bullets. It fires quickly but lacks accuracy.
This weapon temporarily immobilizes opponents with a potent discharge of electricity.

itens.obs: No jogo base é a "caixa de cura" (BOX_HEAL). No Desperate Escape o arquivo uWp31 traz um modelo de torreta.

itens.descricao: This egg is completely rotten. It's turned black. It's not edible at all.
An ordinary egg. It can be used as a weapon.
A brown egg. It's worth more than an ordinary egg.
An extremely rare golden egg. It will fetch a high price in certain markets and is highly coveted.

itens.obs: Modelo uWp7b só no Lost in Nightmares; usa o efeito do machado gigante (wp58). Arma de inimigo ou objeto.

itens.descricao: Ammo for the handgun.
Ammo for the machine gun or assault rifle.
Ammo for the shotgun.
Ammo for the rifle.
Large shells filled with plastic explosives. The wide damage radius can hit multiple targets.
Large shells for use with the grenade launcher. Filled with highly concentrated sulfuric acid.
Large shells filled with liquid nitrogen. Freezes targets upon impact.
Large caliber rounds for use with the magnum.
Large shells filled with a potent chemical. The reaction upon impact creates a conflagration.
Large shells for use with the grenade launcher. Emits a blinding flash and deafening noise upon impact.
Large shells for use with the grenade launcher. Releases a high-powered electric charge upon impact.
A medicinal spray that completely restores one's health.
Restores a quarter of one's health. Its efficiency is greatly increased when combined with another herb.
The red herb has no effect on its own, but can greatly increase the healing properties of a green herb when combined.
A mixture of 2 green herbs. Restores half of one's health.
A health restorative made from the combination of a green herb and a red herb. It will completely restore one's health.
